name: Swan Creek Supply Link
monitor_reason: sponsor and corroboration: single EIA origin only; no independent source found (web search was unavailable this session, limit hit), so the sponsor, route and operating status are unconfirmed. Not a proposed project.
researcher_notes: The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 74, lists Swan Creek Supply Link as a completed new pipeline, in service April 1998, Tennessee, intrastate, 28 miles, 8 inch, 10 MMcf/d, sponsor listed as Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co. An intrastate Tennessee line sponsored by an interstate carrier is odd. It may instead belong to the operator of the Swan Creek gas field in Hancock County, Tennessee, but that was not checked. No existing GEM gas row matches the names Swan Creek, Tengasco, Kingsport or Hawkins in the snapshots searched. Length of 28 miles (about 45 km) would clear the 25 km floor if confirmed. Nothing was staged because there is no second source and no verified ref. Follow up: confirm the sponsor and route with a Tennessee regulator or company document and an independent history of the Swan Creek field.
